items.text: Resolved head and forearm jitter when aiming and ensured remote players rotate fully rather than taking the shortest turn.
Improved C4 behavior with better prediction, fixed rotation blending, and refined hide/show event handling for more reliable detonations.
Rebalanced loot tables in Trainyard, water treatment, and sewer branch rooms.
Added a new monument to the oil rig switch event and introduced extra air drops and satellite selection events.
Fixed cows eating from troughs through other cows and added avoidance behavior to reduce clipping and improve movement in tight spaces.
Simplified older animal AI by removing unreachable states and reducing sight range, making them less likely to detect distant players.
Added critter startle behavior: critters now flee when players get too close.
Implemented an auction system for ranch animal sales, offering three random items with up to two rejections before the vendor becomes unavailable for 15 minutes.
Made only the default sandbag craftable; other variants are now unavailable.

Overhauled sandbag stacking and upgrade system: unified cooldown logic, fixed upgrade cooldown initialization, retained health fraction on upgrades, removed socket‑based placement, added server‑side checks to prevent clipping, and standardized upgrade level handling.
Added ServerSetGod command to modify a player's god status from the server and updated tutorial logic accordingly.

2026-09-16.summary:
### Controls & Combat
- Resolved head and forearm jitter when aiming and ensured remote players rotate fully rather than taking the shortest turn.
- Improved C4 behavior with better prediction, fixed rotation blending, and refined hide/show event handling for more reliable detonations.

### World & Loot & Events
- Rebalanced loot tables in Trainyard, water treatment, and sewer branch rooms.
- Added a new monument to the oil rig switch event and introduced extra air drops and satellite selection events.

### NPCs & Animals
- Fixed cows eating from troughs through other cows and added avoidance behavior to reduce clipping and improve movement in tight spaces.
- Simplified older animal AI by removing unreachable states and reducing sight range, making them less likely to detect distant players.
- Added critter startle behavior: critters now flee when players get too close.
- Implemented an auction system for ranch animal sales, offering three random items with up to two rejections before the vendor becomes unavailable for 15 minutes.

### Structures & Sandbags
- Made only the default sandbag craftable; other variants are now unavailable.
- Overhauled sandbag stacking and upgrade system: unified cooldown logic, fixed upgrade cooldown initialization, retained health fraction on upgrades, removed socket‑based placement, added server‑side checks to prevent clipping, and standardized upgrade level handling.

### Server & Administration
- Added ServerSetGod command to modify a player's god status from the server and updated tutorial logic accordingly.

items.text: Fixed inaccurate server browser gamemode filter counts and prevented mixing of unrelated gamemodes.

Restored missing beef resource links for livestock.
Lamb and calf corpses no longer yield any resources when killed.
Attacking farm animals now marks you as hostile to safezones.
Adjusted critter population settings.
Fixed issues with multiple animals near vehicles and added support for mounting Gen2 AI via a new NPCMountable component.
Halved fence gate opening/closing speed for smoother operation.
Fixed fence collider issues, enabled fence demolition, and added blue highlight to demolishable fences.
Fixed hitbox collision detection errors.
Adjusted salvaged cleaver distance to correct melee reach.
Fixed raw beef missing its cooking reference and added new meat types to all oven prefabs.

2026-09-14.summary:
### Server & UI
- Fixed inaccurate server browser gamemode filter counts and prevented mixing of unrelated gamemodes.
- Fixed various input binding issues, including gamepad key‑assign closure, key latching after input clear, and missing map close binding.

### Animals, Resources & Mounting
- Restored missing beef resource links for livestock.
- Lamb and calf corpses no longer yield any resources when killed.
- Attacking farm animals now marks you as hostile to safezones.
- Adjusted critter population settings.
- Fixed issues with multiple animals near vehicles and added support for mounting Gen2 AI via a new NPCMountable component.

### Structures & Collision
- Halved fence gate opening/closing speed for smoother operation.
- Fixed fence collider issues, enabled fence demolition, and added blue highlight to demolishable fences.
- Fixed hitbox collision detection errors.

### Combat, Weapons & Cooking
- Adjusted salvaged cleaver distance to correct melee reach.
- Fixed raw beef missing its cooking reference and added new meat types to all oven prefabs.

### UI & Visuals
- Store images now correctly generate and display blurhash placeholders, preventing missing or broken backgrounds in the store UI.
- Editor now reads textures as sRGB when possible, improving color accuracy of generated blurhash previews.
